received_works.body:
It is nice to meet you. I saw your illustration in Jig's music video and was attracted to ylu's fragile world, and I would like to commission it.

The characters I would like you to draw are "Oboro Kaname" and "Mikage Sakuya," two characters from a session I had with a friend in the Cthulhu Mythos TRPG "Sardine and Holly.

Sakuya Mikage is a childhood friend and close follower of Kaname Oboro, and Sakuya Mikage is a follower of his. Sakuya is not very self-aware and always listens to Kaname, but she hides her secret love for him and continues to serve him. Kaname to Sakuya: "I want to be with you all the time, but I don't know about love.

Kaname wants to save everyone, but Sakuya only pours out her kindness for Kaname.

Below is a brief summary of the character design in writing.

Oboro Kanayu

Odd eyes with blue left eye and red right eye (no highlights)
Fluffy, super-long twin-tail
Tentacled braids and blue ribbons
White to blue to dark blue gradient toward the ends of the hair
Bat feather hair accessory
Black crinoline

The wings on the skirt, but it would be easier to understand if you refer to the "Night Evil Harness Corset" by Lolita brand Hoshi Boxworks: https://hoshibako.thebase.in/items/84811902

Mikage Sakuya
Blue contacts on left eye, no highlights, right eye black
Decorations can be omitted except for the vest.
The bat wings are wrapped around her arms, and the red ribbon is a matching image of Kaname, tied around her neck and wrists, or held in her hands as shown in the standing image.

Thank you in advance.

Request: Illustration of Rime-sama's song about insectivorous plants.

Anyway, please give me the feel of ylu's usual drawings!

The composition is of my fixed character bringing something to his mouth with a fork. I want butterflies on the handle of the fork and plants scattered throughout the picture. The character is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with his arms rolled up, and gloves (which give the image of a fastidious person). ylu's usual illustration style should be used, so please use a white base for coloring, etc. as usual. I would like to have a kinmokusai flower among the plants scattered about, and I would like the kinmokusai to be painted in an orange-ish color that is close to red, not white, as an accent. I would also like the collar, eyes, and earrings to have the same accent color.

Fixed character details

Hair: Wolf, white hair, red inner color on the collar
Eyes: Slightly reddish
Accessories:Usually a golden osmanthus earring in the left ear, but this time please use some kind of insectivorous plant earring.
